posts.title: Visit to WU Vienna: FMA Breakfast & Classmate Interview
posts.excerpt: Our class visited WU Vienna (Vienna University of Economics and Business) for the FMA Breakfast. Afterwards I interviewed a classmate about what we learned about Austria's Financial Market Authority.

content: In November 2026 our Economics class visited **WU Vienna** (Vienna University of Economics and Business) to attend the **FMA Breakfast**, an event hosted by the Austrian Financial Market Authority (FMA).
After the event I filmed a short interview with a classmate about our impressions of the university and what we learned about how financial markets in Austria are supervised.
